content.title: 身份线索回连｜局部累积到主体确认
content.summary: 先用一致的局部线索建立身份，再回到已见过的面部标记完成确认。

quick_start.input_format: 主体＋三项可复认的局部线索＋最终回连
quick_start.recommended_input: 原创成年海上灯塔维修员；深蓝工作服、普通透明护目镜、沾盐手套、腕部罗盘、肩部安全绳全程固定。晨光下同一座海上灯塔和同一盏信标。
usage_steps: 把示例主体、场景和表层元素替换为原创概念。
让每个必需锚点和 Creative DNA 不可变条件都能在画面因果链中被看见。
选择 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 模板，只填写已声明的可替换项。
生成前检查时长、事件顺序、镜头连续性、声音和反复制约束。
applicable_scope: 先用一致的局部线索建立身份，再回到已见过的面部标记完成确认。
能够保留全部必需锚点的原创 4–15 秒短片。
需要可复用因果视频结构的 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 项目。
not_suitable_for: 要求复制来源人物、场景、道具、对白或镜头顺序的任务。
无法在目标时长内展示全部必需锚点的概念。
缺少紧凑因果链的长篇讲解或无关多地点叙事。

creative_dna.mechanism: Build one stable identity through partial but mutually consistent visual clues; after they accumulate, return to a recognizable head/face marker already glimpsed earlier. The source never supplies a final full-body proof, and the face is not fully concealed at the start. An original transfer may strengthen the closing proof without claiming the source did so.

invariants.rule: Recurring visual design markers across different close crops must remain attributable to one stable character.
invariants.purpose: A later identity echo can only resolve the clue sequence if the earlier clues have one common owner.
invariants.ablation_failure: If details come from different unmarked subjects, the ending cannot support an identity connection and becomes an arbitrary montage.

invariants.rule: The sequence must alternate several body regions while repeating at least one design marker; not every crop has to introduce new information.
invariants.purpose: The middle sustains familiarity and variation before the final identity echo.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the montage stays on only one undifferentiated crop, the later eye/head echo no longer gathers dispersed details into one recognizable design.

invariants.rule: The ending returns to a previously glimpsed identity marker and preserves recurring design cues, without requiring a source full-body view.
invariants.purpose: Provides a recognizable identity echo after the detail ladder rather than an unrelated final insert.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the ending drops the earlier identity marker and recurring cues, the fragment sequence no longer resolves to a recognizable stable character.

slots.name: subject_identity
slots.constraint: One original figure with a stable design; a human version must be clearly adult, but the mechanism also works with a non-human figure.

slots.name: clue_objects
slots.constraint: Three or more original details attributable to one subject; a transfer may reconnect them more explicitly than the source.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: One new environment with a stable direction or landmark; avoid the source's blank-field anime design.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: Close detail views and a final recognizable identity echo; an optional wider whole-subject proof is an original strengthening, not a source claim.

slots.name: decisive_action
slots.constraint: An optional original role-confirming action can strengthen the new instance without being attributed to the source.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: Original, action-linked sound design; no claim that the source music or effects were heard.

anti_copy_exclusions: Do not reproduce the source anime character's face, red eyes, black strappy costume, gold hair ornaments or body proportions.
Do not copy the original exact crop order, cut timings, palette or bare-white visual field.
Do not use creator names, franchise identifiers, source caption wording or creator prompt text.

instantiations.concept: An adult offshore lighthouse maintainer is identified through salt-stained gloves, a wrist compass and safety line before activating a beacon.
instantiations.prompt_seed: A live-action offshore lighthouse maintainer performs one beacon activation; three accumulated equipment clues reconnect in a final whole-person tower view.

instantiations.concept: A stop-motion brass courier automaton is introduced through a stamped wheel, folded paper wing and blue-glass eye before its head returns in a miniature post-office set.
instantiations.prompt_seed: A handcrafted stop-motion automaton cycles through wheel, paper wing and eye details; a final head/eye echo recalls the opening, without copying the source costume or requiring a full-body reveal.

failure_modes.failure: Details drift between actors or outfits.
failure_modes.repair: Define one subject and retain three identical visual anchors through every crop and the final whole-person view.

failure_modes.failure: Crops are pretty but do not add information.
failure_modes.repair: Make each crop reveal a different role clue and omit repetitive purely decorative inserts.

failure_modes.failure: The final shot shows an unrelated person or drops all earlier design cues.
failure_modes.repair: Repeat a previously seen identity marker and at least one recurring cue; an original whole-subject framing may strengthen the result but is not required by source evidence.

transfer_tests.concept: An adult offshore lighthouse maintainer is identified through salt-stained gloves, a wrist compass and safety line before activating a beacon.
A stop-motion brass courier automaton is introduced through a stamped wheel, folded paper wing and blue-glass eye before its head returns in a miniature post-office set.
